source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban climate governance" OR ("climate change" AND (city OR cities) AND (adaptation OR governance OR justice))
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban climate governance" OR ("climate change" AND (city OR cities) AND (adaptation OR governance OR justice)),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban climate governance" OR ("climate change" AND ("adaptation" OR "governance" OR "justice") AND ("cities" OR "city")))
